instructions.question: Two Claude sessions work in the same repository. `claim` is work one session has already taken on; `topic` is work another session is about to start. Would doing `topic` duplicate or collide with `claim`?
instructions.note: The two are written by different sessions, so the same bug or feature is often phrased differently. Judge the work, not the wording.

criteria.true: It is the same bug, feature or change, or it edits the same code toward the same end — doing both would duplicate effort or produce conflicting changes.
criteria.false: It is different work that can proceed in parallel, even if it touches the same area of the codebase.
